The color you're referring to is yellow. Yellow is a primary color in the additive color model, which means it is one of the three basic colors that can be mixed together to create other colors. In the RGB color model used by computer monitors and digital cameras, yellow is represented by the combination of red and green light.

Yellow is often associated with warmth, happiness, and sunshine. It can also symbolize caution or attention, as it is the color of traffic lights for pedestrians. In the hexadecimal color code system, yellow is represented by the code #FFFF00.
